name: get-app-icon
title: Get App Icon
description: Quickly save or copy an app's icon in multiple sizes and formats.
author: chrismessina

preferences.name: defaultViewMode
preferences.title: Default View
preferences.description: Choose whether to display applications as a list or grid by default

preferences.name: outputPath
preferences.title: Output Folder
preferences.description: Where exported icons are saved. Each app gets its own subfolder.

preferences.name: defaultExportSize
preferences.title: Default Size
preferences.description: Size used by Export Icons. Use Export Icon Size… for a one-off, or Export All Sizes for every size.

preferences.name: formatPng
preferences.title: PNG
preferences.label: Export PNG
preferences.description: Lossless, transparent background. The safe default.

preferences.name: formatIcns
preferences.title: ICNS
preferences.label: Export ICNS
preferences.description: The app's original .icns file. Unavailable for apps with Asset Catalogs.

commands.name: get-app-icon
commands.title: Get App Icon
commands.description: Quickly save an app's icon in multiple sizes and formats.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
